cmdkit.midnightconfig.executeCmdSocketPo: The port for the command execution service socket binding. The default value is 0, which means the service will be disabled. If you modify this value, it will be applied when the program restarts.
cmdkit.midnightconfig.manageDatapackSock: The port for the datapack management service socket binding. The default value is 0, which means the service will be disabled. If you modify this value, it will be applied when the program restarts.
cmdkit.midnightconfig.shouldShowSocketIn: Show the server socket info in the message field for the trusted clients.
cmdkit.midnightconfig.suggestCmdSocketPo: The port for the command suggestion service socket binding. The default value is 0, which means the service will be disabled. If you modify this value, it will be applied when the program restarts.
cmdkit.midnightconfig.title: Command Debug Service Config
cmdkit.midnightconfig.trustMode.tooltip: The client socket trust mode for the [Command Debug Service].
cmdkit.midnightconfig.trustedIPv4Address: The white list for the Command Debug Service. Only clients recorded in this list are allowed to connect in WHITE_LIST mode.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cmdkit: This is a mod that provides a method to execute and debug Minecraft commands by creating socket connections between Minecraft and external programs. It is used to be a command debug connect kit between Minecraft and external programs.
